name: Scorching Ray
description: Level 2 Evocation (Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: 120 feet Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous You hurl three fiery rays. You can hurl them at one target within range or at several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2.
